patthana8.63:1.1: na sappītikaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na sappītiko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: tīṇi.
patthana8.63:2.1: na appītikaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na appītiko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: tīṇi.
patthana8.63:3.1: na sappītikañca na appītikañca dhammaṃ paṭicca na sappītiko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: tīṇi.
